questions.q: Where do you set up a scheduled export?
options: A separate Setup menu item called "Scheduled Backups"
The same Data Export page used for manual exports, via the Schedule Export button
Only through the command-line Data Loader interface
Through a report subscription
questions.explain: Schedule Export lives on the same Data Export Setup page as Export Now — just a different button leading to a similar options screen plus a frequency setting.

questions.q: Which editions can schedule a weekly export?
options: Every Salesforce edition, including Essentials
Enterprise, Performance, and Unlimited Edition
Only Developer Edition orgs
Weekly scheduling isn't available in any edition
questions.explain: Weekly frequency is available in Enterprise, Performance, and Unlimited Edition orgs; other editions are limited to a monthly cadence.

questions.q: How long are a scheduled export's files available for download once it completes?
options: Indefinitely, until manually deleted
48 hours, the same window as a manual export
7 days
Only until the next scheduled export begins
questions.explain: Scheduled exports follow the same 48-hour download window as manual exports — someone needs to download and store the files if longer retention is required.

questions.q: What is the main advantage of a scheduled export over relying on manual Export Now runs?
options: Scheduled exports include more object types than manual ones
It removes the human step — the backup happens whether or not anyone remembers
Scheduled exports never expire, unlike manual ones
Scheduled exports run instantly with no processing delay
questions.explain: The core benefit is reliability: a scheduled export runs on its cadence automatically, instead of depending on someone remembering to trigger it manually.

questions.q: An org's edition only allows monthly scheduled exports, but the team wants backups more often. What's a realistic option?
options: It's impossible to export more often than the scheduled cadence allows
Supplement the monthly schedule with manual Export Now runs, or use Data Loader's Export operation on a tighter cadence
Upgrade is the only option; nothing else can be done
Monthly scheduled exports can be manually sped up through Setup
questions.explain: The scheduled service's frequency is capped by edition, but nothing stops running Export Now manually more often, or using Data Loader's Export operation (possibly automated outside Salesforce) for more frequent backups.
